claims.subject: TR202 LOX/LH2 expander engine throttling
claims.object: 8,725 lbf vacuum thrust at 100% power down to 1,600 lbf at 18.8%; nominal operation at 75% power with 4:1 throttling
claims.statement: The TR202 closed-expander LOX/LH2 engine with a variable-area pintle injector provides 8,725 lbf vacuum thrust at 100% power and throttles to 1,600 lbf at 18.8%; it was designed to operate nominally at 75% power with 4:1 throttling capability, derived from vehicle trade studies for NASA's Lunar Surface Access Module.
claims.quote: designed to nominally operate at 75% power with 4:1 throttling capability

claims.subject: TR202 test-bed pintle injector
claims.object: performance over a deep 10:1 throttle range; >98% C* in the 75-100% power band; stable combustion and measured heat transfer over 10:1
claims.statement: The LOX/GH2 test-bed pintle injector was designed to demonstrate and optimize performance over a deep 10:1 throttle range, with primary objectives of more than 98% C* in the 75%-100% power band, stable combustion and total chamber heat-transfer measurement over 10:1, and adequate thermal power for expander-cycle closure.
claims.quote: Demonstrate high-performance (>98% C*) within 75%-100% power band
